career_ladder.note: Administrative Officers (Scale I) in United India Insurance Company Limited (UIIC), headquartered in Chennai, lead non-life insurance operations, underwriting, claim settlements, corporate reinsurance, and institutional marketing across regional and branch networks nationwide under General Insurance Public Sector Association (GIPSA) guidelines.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for UIIC Administrative Officers (Scale-I) is conducted through an Online Objective Examination followed by a Personal Interview. Negative marking of 1/4th (0.25 marks) is deducted for each incorrect answer across all objective sections.

stages.source_label: UIIC — Scheme of Online Examination for Administrative Officers

papers.paper_name: General Awareness (with special reference to Financial Sector)

papers.qualifying_threshold: Sectional cut-off applicable (20 questions; total composite time 120 minutes)

papers.paper_name: Personal Interview (Online test score and interview marks are weighted for final merit selection)

financial_package.pay_source_label: General Insurance (Officers) Revision of Pay Rules, Scale I Pay Scale (₹50,925 - 2,500(14) - 85,925 - 2,710(4) - 96,765)
financial_package.estimate_note: Starting basic pay is ₹50,925/month. Total monthly gross emoluments are approximately ₹85,000/month in metropolitan centers. Emoluments include Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance (where company accommodation is not provided), City Compensatory Allowance, and Transport Allowance. Deductions comprise NPS contribution and applicable taxes.
official_perks: Company leased residential accommodation or House Rent Allowance per city classification
Comprehensive medical coverage and cashless hospitalization for officer and family dependents
Leave Travel Subsidy (LTS) / Home Town travel once in two years
Defined contribution benefits under National Pension System (NPS) and Group Life Insurance
Subsidized insurance policies, festival advance, and brief-case reimbursement
Conveyance / petrol reimbursement and official telephone/broadband expense coverage

competition_benchmarks.note: UIIC is a leading public sector general insurance company in India with over 1,400 offices; its Administrative Officer recruitment attracts applicants nationwide seeking managerial careers in non-life insurance underwriting, risk, and corporate claims.
